description.text: Fifteen single attacks (0.60 each), causes [Imperil Earth 10% (15s)]/[Imperil Earth 20% (15s)]/[Imperil Earth 30% (15s)] if 1/2/3+ of Galuf, Kelger and Xexat are alive and three or more FF5 allies are alive, grants [Attach Earth 3 with Stacking], [Synchro Mode], and [Damage Cap +10000] to the user, grants [50% Damage Reduction Barrier 1] to all allies, grants [Crystal Warden Mode] to the user if 3+ FF5 allies are alive
